name: Svinka Peppa ili problemy rossijskogo televidenija
original_name: Свинка Пеппа или проблемы российского телевидения
source:
Peppa Pig is feeling unwell, just like the rest of us. After all, an infection has penetrated her world, too, Russian television. But the Pig is not sitting idly by, and her revenge will be fabulously cunning!
